nodes.label: Elfo Sprite (Male Elf Archer)
nodes.rationale: Full-body 2D character illustration on a transparent/white background, used as a selectable male avatar sprite (sprites-2d/man set). Fantasy elf ranger pose: drawing an arrow from a back quiver while holding a longbow.

nodes.label: Elf Ranger / Archer Character
nodes.rationale: Male elf with pointed ears and a long braided brown hair, wearing a hooded tunic, flowing cloak, belted pouches, bracers and tall boots; fantasy archetype for the male sprite roster.

nodes.label: Monochrome Blue Flat Line-Art Style
nodes.rationale: Flat-fill, black-outlined cartoon illustration with a limited navy/slate/light-blue palette and skin/brown accents; limited palette suits small PNG sprite assets and a consistent 2D character set.
